audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for many dwelling places, way/truth/life, seeing Father, asking in name, love/commands, Paraclete, Spirit of truth, mutual indwelling, peace, ruler of world.

verses.restored: Do not let your heart be troubled; trust into the Divine, and trust into me.

familiar.text: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

modern.text: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.

original.text: Μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία· πιστεύετε εἰς τὸν θεόν, καὶ εἰς ἐμὲ πιστεύετε.

verses.restored: In my Father's house are many dwelling places; if not, would I have told you that I go to prepare a place for you?

familiar.text: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

modern.text: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?

original.text: ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ τοῦ πατρός μου μοναὶ πολλαί εἰσιν· εἰ δὲ μή, εἶπον ἂν ὑμῖν ⸀ὅτι πορεύομαι ἑτοιμάσαι τόπον ὑμῖν·

verses.restored: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I come again and will receive you to myself, so that where I am, you also may be.

familiar.text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

modern.text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.

original.text: καὶ ἐὰν πορευθῶ ⸀καὶ ἑτοιμάσω ⸂τόπον ὑμῖν⸃, πάλιν ἔρχομαι καὶ παραλήμψομαι ὑμᾶς πρὸς ἐμαυτόν, ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἦτε.

verses.restored: And where I am going, you know the way.

familiar.text: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.

modern.text: You know the way to the place where I am going. ” The Way, the Truth, and the Life

original.text: καὶ ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω οἴδατε ⸂τὴν ὁδόν⸃.

verses.restored: Thomas says to him, Lord, we do not know where you are going; how are we able to know the way?

familiar.text: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?

modern.text: “Lord,” said Thomas, “we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?”

original.text: λέγει αὐτῷ Θωμᾶς· Κύριε, οὐκ οἴδαμεν ποῦ ὑπάγεις· ⸀πῶς ⸂δυνάμεθα τὴν ὁδὸν εἰδέναι⸃;

verses.restored: Jesus says to him, I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

familiar.text: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

modern.text: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.

original.text: λέγει αὐτῷ ⸀ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ὁδὸς καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια καὶ ἡ ζωή· οὐδεὶς ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸν πατέρα εἰ μὴ διʼ ἐμοῦ.

verses.restored: If you have known me, you will know my Father also; from now you know him and have seen him.

familiar.text: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

modern.text: If you had known Me, you would know My Father as well. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him.”

original.text: εἰ ⸀ἐγνώκειτέ με, καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου ⸂ἂν ᾔδειτε⸃· ⸀ἀπʼ ἄρτι γινώσκετε αὐτὸν καὶ ἑωράκατε ⸀αὐτόν.

verses.restored: Philip says to him, Lord, show us the Father, and it is enough for us.

familiar.text: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

modern.text: Philip said to Him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

original.text: Λέγει αὐτῷ Φίλιππος· Κύριε, δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν πατέρα, καὶ ἀρκεῖ ἡμῖν.

verses.restored: Jesus says to him, Have I been with you so long a time, and you have not known me, Philip? The one who has seen me has seen the Father; how do you say, Show us the Father?

familiar.text: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?

modern.text: Jesus replied, “Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

original.text: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· ⸂Τοσούτῳ χρόνῳ⸃ μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰμι καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωκάς με, Φίλιππε; ὁ ἑωρακὼς ἐμὲ ἑώρακεν τὸν πατέρα· ⸀πῶς σὺ λέγεις· Δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν πατέρα;

verses.restored: Do you not trust that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words I say to you I do not speak from myself, but the Father remaining in me does his works.

familiar.text: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

modern.text: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I say to you, I do not speak on My own. Instead, it is the Father dwelling in Me, performing His works.

original.text: οὐ πιστεύεις ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρὶ καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί ἐστιν; τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐγὼ ⸀λέγω ὑμῖν ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐ λαλῶ, ὁ δὲ ⸀πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοὶ ⸀μένων ποιεῖ τὰ ἔργα ⸀αὐτοῦ.

verses.restored: Trust me that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; but if not, trust because of the works themselves.

familiar.text: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

modern.text: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me—or at least believe on account of the works themselves.

original.text: πιστεύετέ μοι ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρὶ καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί· εἰ δὲ μή, διὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτὰ ⸀πιστεύετε.

verses.restored: Amen, amen, I say to you: the one trusting into me will also do the works that I do, and greater than these will do, because I go to the Father.

familiar.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

modern.text: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.

original.text: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ κἀκεῖνος ποιήσει, καὶ μείζονα τούτων ποιήσει, ὅτι ἐγὼ πρὸς τὸν ⸀πατέρα πορεύομαι·

verses.restored: Whatever you ask in my name, this I will do, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

familiar.text: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

modern.text: And I will do whatever you ask in My name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

original.text: καὶ ὅ τι ἂν αἰτήσητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου τοῦτο ποιήσω, ἵνα δοξασθῇ ὁ πατὴρ ἐν τῷ υἱῷ·

verses.restored: If you ask me anything in my name, I will do it.

familiar.text: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

modern.text: If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it. Jesus Promises the Holy Spirit (John 16:5–16)

original.text: ἐάν τι αἰτήσητέ ⸀με ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου ⸀ἐγὼ ποιήσω.

verses.restored: If you love me, you will keep my commands.

familiar.text: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

modern.text: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.

original.text: Ἐὰν ἀγαπᾶτέ με, τὰς ἐντολὰς τὰς ἐμὰς ⸀τηρήσετε·

verses.restored: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Advocate/Paraclete, so that he may be with you into the age,

familiar.text: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

modern.text: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—

original.text: κἀγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν πατέρα καὶ ἄλλον παράκλητον δώσει ὑμῖν ἵνα ⸀ᾖ μεθʼ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν ⸀αἰῶνα,

verses.restored: the Spirit of truth, whom the world is not able to receive, because it neither beholds him nor knows him. You know him, because he remains beside you and will be in you.

familiar.text: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

modern.text: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.

original.text: τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας, ὃ ὁ κόσμος οὐ δύναται λαβεῖν, ὅτι οὐ θεωρεῖ αὐτὸ οὐδὲ ⸀γινώσκει· ⸀ὑμεῖς γινώσκετε αὐτό, ὅτι παρʼ ὑμῖν μένει καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ⸀ἔσται.

verses.restored: I will not leave you orphaned; I am coming to you.

familiar.text: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

modern.text: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

original.text: Οὐκ ἀφήσω ὑμᾶς ὀρφανούς, ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς.

verses.restored: Yet a little while, and the world beholds me no longer; but you behold me. Because I live, you also will live.

familiar.text: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

modern.text: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.

original.text: ἔτι μικρὸν καὶ ὁ κόσμος με οὐκέτι θεωρεῖ, ὑμεῖς δὲ θεωρεῖτέ με, ὅτι ἐγὼ ζῶ καὶ ὑμεῖς ⸀ζήσετε.

verses.restored: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

familiar.text: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

modern.text: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I am in you.

original.text: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ⸂γνώσεσθε ὑμεῖς⸃ ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ πατρί μου καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν.

verses.restored: The one having my commands and keeping them, that one is the one loving me; and the one loving me will be loved by my Father, and I will love that one and reveal myself to that one.

familiar.text: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

modern.text: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”

original.text: ὁ ἔχων τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ τηρῶν αὐτὰς ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαπῶν με· ὁ δὲ ἀγαπῶν με ἀγαπηθήσεται ὑπὸ τοῦ πατρός μου, κἀγὼ ἀγαπήσω αὐτὸν καὶ ἐμφανίσω αὐτῷ ἐμαυτόν.

verses.restored: Judas, not Iscariot, says to him, Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us and not to the world?

familiar.text: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

modern.text: Judas (not Iscariot) asked Him, “Lord, why are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?”

original.text: λέγει αὐτῷ Ἰούδας, οὐχ ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης· Κύριε, ⸀τί γέγονεν ὅτι ἡμῖν μέλλεις ἐμφανίζειν σεαυτὸν καὶ οὐχὶ τῷ κόσμῳ;

verses.restored: Jesus answered and said to him, If anyone loves me, that one will keep my word, and my Father will love that one, and we will come to that one and make our dwelling place with that one.

familiar.text: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

modern.text: Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.

original.text: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ με τὸν λόγον μου τηρήσει, καὶ ὁ πατήρ μου ἀγαπήσει αὐτόν, καὶ πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐλευσόμεθα καὶ μονὴν παρʼ αὐτῷ ⸀ποιησόμεθα.

verses.restored: The one not loving me does not keep my words; and the word you hear is not mine, but the Father's who sent me.

familiar.text: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.

modern.text: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words. The word that you hear is not My own, but it is from the Father who sent Me.

original.text: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν με τοὺς λόγους μου οὐ τηρεῖ· καὶ ὁ λόγος ὃν ἀκούετε οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὸς ἀλλὰ τοῦ πέμψαντός με πατρός.

verses.restored: These things I have spoken to you while remaining with you.

familiar.text: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

modern.text: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.

original.text: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν παρʼ ὑμῖν μένων·

verses.restored: But the Advocate/Paraclete, the holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, that one will teach you all things and remind you of all things I said to you.

familiar.text: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

modern.text: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you. Peace I Leave with You

original.text: ὁ δὲ παράκλητος, τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ὃ πέμψει ὁ πατὴρ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου, ἐκεῖνος ὑμᾶς διδάξει πάντα καὶ ὑπομνήσει ὑμᾶς πάντα ἃ εἶπον ⸀ὑμῖν.

verses.restored: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Do not let your heart be troubled, nor let it be afraid.

familiar.text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

modern.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

original.text: εἰρήνην ἀφίημι ὑμῖν, εἰρήνην τὴν ἐμὴν δίδωμι ὑμῖν· οὐ καθὼς ὁ κόσμος δίδωσιν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν. μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία μηδὲ δειλιάτω.

verses.restored: You heard that I said to you, I go away and I come to you. If you loved me, you would rejoice that I go to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.

familiar.text: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

modern.text: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.

original.text: ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν· Ὑπάγω καὶ ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς. εἰ ἠγαπᾶτέ με ἐχάρητε ἄν, ⸀ὅτι πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα, ὅτι ὁ ⸀πατὴρ μείζων μού ἐστιν.

verses.restored: Now I have told you before it happens, so that when it happens you may trust.

familiar.text: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.

modern.text: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.

original.text: καὶ νῦν εἴρηκα ὑμῖν πρὶν γενέσθαι, ἵνα ὅταν γένηται πιστεύσητε.

verses.restored: I will no longer speak much with you, for the ruler of the world comes; and in me he has nothing.

familiar.text: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

modern.text: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.

original.text: οὐκέτι πολλὰ λαλήσω μεθʼ ὑμῶν, ἔρχεται γὰρ ὁ τοῦ κόσμου ἄρχων· καὶ ἐν ἐμοὶ οὐκ ἔχει οὐδέν,

verses.restored: But so that the world may know that I love the Father, and just as the Father commanded me, so I do. Rise, let us go from here.

familiar.text: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

modern.text: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.

original.text: ἀλλʼ ἵνα γνῷ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι ἀγαπῶ τὸν πατέρα, καὶ καθὼς ⸀ἐνετείλατο μοι ὁ πατὴρ οὕτως ποιῶ. Ἐγείρεσθε, ἄγωμεν ἐντεῦθεν.
